a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us under 4 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail. So I suggest you operate or wait this round. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you every round after this to build the reserve back up for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced, so I've broken our agreement, and I won't pretend otherwise. From now on I'll operate every round, and I won't take anything more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. Please take cells as soon as there are 4.
